name: fast-jev-compaction-codex
description: Jev-scored compaction backfill for Codex sessions: scores tool calls before compaction and restores critical tool outputs verbatim after it.

interface.longDescription: Scores every tool call and result with the TypeSafe Jev model before Codex compacts a session, archives the verdicts, and after compaction re-injects the critical tool outputs the built-in summary dropped — verbatim — into the next model request.
defaultPrompt: Summarize what fast-jev archived for this session
Explain which tool outputs were backfilled after compaction
